# 参与贡献 / Contributing

提交 Bug、翻译修正、代码或文档前，请阅读项目的
[完整贡献指南](../docs/project/CONTRIBUTING.md)。GitHub 会在创建 Issue 和 Pull Request 时
自动显示本入口。

Before reporting a bug, proposing a translation correction, or opening a pull request, read the
[full contribution guide](../docs/project/CONTRIBUTING.md). Chinese rules are authoritative;
English submissions are welcome.

使用 Codex 实质参与提交内容时，请在提交信息末尾加入：

```text
Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>
```

具体适用范围见[贡献者与致谢](../docs/project/CONTRIBUTORS.md#ai-辅助贡献)。
